<p style="margin-top:2pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">As of February&#160;8, 2019, there were approximately 3,176 registered holders of Allergan plc&#8217;s Ordinary Shares.</p>
<p style="margin-top:2pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">We have paid cash dividends on ordinary shares quarterly beginning with the 2017 fiscal year. </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-top:2pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company paid a quarterly dividend on shares of its mandatory convertible preferred shares, which were converted to ordinary shares on March 1, 2018.</p>
<p style="margin-top:2pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Warner Chilcott Limited is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Allergan and has no publicly traded equity securities.</p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Issuer Purchases of Equity Securities</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">During the quarter ended December&#160;31, 2018, we repurchased 32,168&#160;of Allergan plc&#8217;s Ordinary Shares to satisfy tax withholding obligations in connection with the vesting of restricted stock issued to employees and directors.&nbsp;&nbsp;On July 26, 2018, the Company&#8217;s Board of Directors approved a $2.0 billion share repurchase program, of which we repurchased $1,200.2 million of our Ordinary Shares in the year ended December 31, 2018.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;color:#000000;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">On January 29, 2019, the Company announced that its Board of Directors approved a separate $2.0 billion share repurchase program. </p>

(&#8220;Legacy Allergan&#8221;) for approximately $77.0 billion (the &#8220;Allergan Acquisition&#8221;). </p></td></tr></table></div>

<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">49</a></p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<tr>
<td valign="top" style="width:9.07%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">ITEM&#160;7.</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:bold;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU50"></a><a name="ITEM_7_MANAGEMENTS_DISCUSSION_ANALYSIS_F"></a><font style="font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"></font><font style="font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"></font><font style="font-style:italic;"><a name="ITEM_7_MANAGEMENTS_DISCUSSION_ANALYSIS_F"></a>MANAGEMENT&#8217;S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS OF</font><font style="font-style:italic;"> FINANCIAL CONDITION AND RESULTS OF OPERATIONS</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The following discussion contains forward-looking statements that are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and other factors that may cause actual results to differ materially from those expressed or implied by such forward-looking statements. We discuss such risks, uncertainties and other factors throughout this report and specifically under the caption &#8220;Cautionary Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements&#8221; under &#8220;ITEM&#160;1A. RISK FACTORS&#8221; in this document. In addition, the following discussion of financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with the Consolidated Financial Statements and Notes thereto included elsewhere in this document.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The results of Warner Chilcott Limited are consolidated into the results of Allergan plc. Due to the deminimis activity between Allergan plc and Warner Chilcott Limited, references throughout this section relate to both Allergan plc and Warner Chilcott Limited.</p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">EXECUTIVE SUMMARY</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Overview</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Allergan plc is a global pharmaceutical leader.&#160;Allergan is focused on developing, manufacturing and commercializing branded pharmaceutical, device, biologic, surgical and regenerative medicine products for patients around the world.&nbsp;&nbsp;Allergan markets a portfolio of leading brands and best-in-class products primarily focused on four key therapeutic areas including medical aesthetics, eye care, central nervous system and gastroenterology.&nbsp;&nbsp;<font style="letter-spacing:-0.1pt;">Allergan is an industry leader in Open Science, a model of research and development, which defines our approach to identifying and developing game-changing ideas and innovation for better patient care.</font><font style="letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-size:12pt;">&nbsp;&nbsp;</font>The Company has operations in more than 100 countries.&nbsp;&nbsp;Warner Chilcott Limited is an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of Allergan plc and has the same principal business activities. </p>
<p style="Background-color:#FFFFFF;margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Discontinued Operations</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:12pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">On August 2, 2016 we completed the Teva Transaction for $38.3 billion of cash and Teva shares.&nbsp;&nbsp;On October 3, 2016, the Company completed the divestiture of the Anda Distribution business to Teva<font style="color:#000000;"> for $500.0 million</font>.&nbsp;&nbsp;<font style="color:#000000;">The Company recognized a combined gain on the sale of the Anda Distribution business and the Teva Transaction of $15,932.2 million in the year ended December 31, 2016.&nbsp;&nbsp;</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In October 2016, pursuant to our agreement with Teva, Teva provided the Company with its proposed estimated adjustment to the closing date working capital balance.&#160; The Company disagreed with Teva&#8217;s proposed adjustment, and, pursuant to our agreement with Teva, each of the Company&#8217;s and Teva&#8217;s proposed adjustments were submitted to arbitration (the &#8220;Working Capital Arbitration&#8221;) to determine the working capital amount in accordance with GAAP as applied by the Company consistent with past practice.&#160; On January 31, 2018, Allergan plc and Teva entered into an agreement pursuant to which the Company made a one-time payment of $700.0 million to Teva.&nbsp;&nbsp;As a result, the Company recorded a pre-tax charge of $466.0 million as a component of other (expense) / income, net from discontinued operations relating to the settlement in the year ended December 31, 2017.&nbsp;&nbsp;The one-time payment of $700.0 million, which represents a refund of purchase price, is shown in the Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows as both a cash outflow in investing activities of $466.0 million and a cash outflow in financing cash flows of $234.0 million for the portion of the payment which was outstanding greater than one year in the year ended December 31, 2018.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:12pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">As a result of the&#160;Teva&#160;Transaction and the divestiture of the Company&#8217;s&#160;Anda&#160;Distribution business, and in accordance with&#160;FASB ASU No. 2014-08 &#8220;Presentation of Financial Statements (Topic 205) and Property, Plant and Equipment (Topic 360): Reporting Discontinued Operations and Disclosures of Disposals of Components of an Entity&#8221;, the financial results of the businesses held for sale were reclassified to discontinued operations for all periods presented in our consolidated financial statements.&#160;The results of our discontinued operations include the results of our generic product&#160;development, manufacturing and distribution of off-patent pharmaceutical products, certain established international brands marketed similarly to generic products and out-licensed generic pharmaceutical products primarily in Europe through our&#160;Medis&#160;third-party business through August 2, 2016, as well as our&#160;Anda&#160;Distribution business&#160;through October 3, 2016.<font style="letter-spacing:-0.1pt;font-size:12pt;"> </font></p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">50</a></p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:2.27%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU51"></a><font style="font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Significant Business Developments</font></p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Refer to the Business Development section in ITEM&#160;1. BUSINESS for the significant transactions that were completed or announced in the years ended December 31, 2018, 2017 and 2016.</p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Segments </p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company&#8217;s businesses are organized into the following segments: US Specialized Therapeutics, US General Medicine and International. In addition, certain revenues and shared costs, and the results of corporate initiatives, are managed outside of the three segments.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The operating segments are organized as follows:</p>

<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company defines segment net revenues as product sales and other revenue derived from our products or licensing agreements. </p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Cost of sales within segment contribution includes standard production and packaging costs for the products we manufacture, third party acquisition costs for products manufactured by others, profit-sharing or royalty payments for products sold pursuant to licensing agreements and finished goods inventory reserve charges.&nbsp;&nbsp;Cost of sales within segment contribution excludes non-standard production costs, such as non-finished goods inventory obsolescence charges, manufacturing variances and excess capacity utilization charges, where applicable. Cost of sales does not include amortization or impairment costs for acquired product rights or other acquired intangibles.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:12pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Selling and marketing expenses consist mainly of personnel-related costs, product promotion costs, distribution costs, professional service costs, insurance, depreciation and travel costs. </p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">General and administrative expenses consist mainly of personnel-related costs, facilities costs, transaction costs, insurance, depreciation, litigation costs and professional services costs which are general in nature and attributable to the segment. </p>

<td valign="middle"  BGCOLOR="#CFF0FC" style="padding-left:0pt;padding-Right:0.75pt;padding-Top:0.75pt;padding-Bottom:0pt;width:0.98%;white-space:nowrap;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-left:0pt;;text-indent:0pt;;color:#000000;font-size:1pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&nbsp;</p></td>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-top:8pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:2.27%;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Net Revenues</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2018 and 2017</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The increase in net revenues in the year ended December 31, 2018 was primarily driven by the Zeltiq Acquisition and the LifeCell Acquisition and growth in Botox<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> Therapeutics and Botox<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> Cosmetics, partially offset by decreases in Restasis<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> and the divestiture of our Medical Dermatology business.&nbsp;&nbsp;Botox<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> Therapeutics and Botox<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> Cosmetics increased versus the prior year period primarily driven by demand growth.&nbsp;&nbsp;The decline in Restasis<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> revenues was due to both price declines and volume declines as a result of changes in promotional efforts ahead of an anticipated launch of a generic.&nbsp;&nbsp;As a result of the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Texas issuing an adverse trial decision finding that the four asserted patents covering Restasis<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> (Cyclosporine Ophthalmic Emulsion) 0.05% are invalid, there is a potential risk for future declines in Restasis<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> revenues.&nbsp;&nbsp;The decline in Aczone<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> revenues prior to divestiture was due to genericization of the branded acne market, increased discounts to maintain formulary access and a generic launch of Aczone 5%.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2017 and 2016</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The increase in net revenues in the year ended December 31, 2017 was primarily driven by growth in Botox<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> Therapeutics, Facial Aesthetics and the LifeCell Acquisition and Zeltiq Acquisition.&nbsp;&nbsp;Botox<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> Therapeutics increased versus the prior year period driven by demand growth.&nbsp;&nbsp;The increase in Facial Aesthetics revenues was driven, in part, by Botox<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> Cosmetics primarily due to demand growth.&nbsp;&nbsp;Also contributing was an increase in Juvederm<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> Collection revenues primarily due to demand and an increase in market share, offset, in part, by an increase in discounts.&nbsp;&nbsp;The decline in Aczone revenues was due to genericization of the branded acne market.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:2.27%;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Cost of Sales</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2018 and 2017</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The decrease in segment gross margin was due in part to the Zeltiq Acquisition and the LifeCell Acquisition.&nbsp;&nbsp;Excluding Zeltiq Acquisition and the LifeCell Acquisition in both periods, segment gross margin decreased to 94.2% in the year ended December 31, 2018 versus 94.8% in the prior year period primarily due to product mix, including a decline in Restasis<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> sales.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2017 and 2016</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The decrease in segment gross margin was primarily the result of the LifeCell Acquisition and the Zeltiq Acquisition, which contributed lower margin products to the segment.&nbsp;&nbsp;Excluding the LifeCell Acquisition and the Zeltiq Acquisition, segment gross margin was 94.8% in the year ended December 31, 2017, in line with 95.0% in the prior year period.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">55</a></p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:2.27%;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU55"></a><font style="font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Selling and Marketing Expenses</font></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2018 and 2017</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The decrease in selling and marketing expenses in the year ended December 31, 2018 was primarily related to lower headcount in the Eye Care and Medical Dermatology field forces due to the Company&#8217;s restructuring initiatives, lower promotional costs and a decrease in the charge for the non-tax deductible Branded Prescription Drug Fee, offset in part by the impact of the Zeltiq Acquisition and the LifeCell Acquisition.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2017 and 2016</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The increase in selling and marketing expenses was primarily related to increased costs from the LifeCell Acquisition and the Zeltiq Acquisition of $193.9 million as well as increased promotional costs for Rhofade<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174; </sup>and Xen.</p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:2.27%;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">General and Administrative Expenses</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2018 and 2017</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">General and administrative expenses remained stable period over period.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2017 and 2016</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The increase in general and administrative expenses was primarily due to the LifeCell Acquisition and Zeltiq Acquisition and additional bad debt write-offs of $7.9 million.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">56</a></p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">

<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">57</a></p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-top:8pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:2.27%;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Net Revenues</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2018 and 2017</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The decrease in net revenues in the year ended December 31, 2018 was primarily due to a decline in products that lost exclusivity, including Namenda XR<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, Estrace<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> Cream, and Minastrin<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> 24, as well as a decline in Other Diversified Brands, offset, in part, by growth in Vraylar<font style="font-size:12pt;"><sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup></font>, Lo Loestrin<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> and<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top"> </sup>Linzess<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>.&nbsp;&nbsp;CNS revenues declined primarily due to the decline in Namenda XR<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> as a result of loss of exclusivity, offset, in part, by strong demand growth for Vraylar<font style="font-size:12pt;"><sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup></font>.&nbsp;&nbsp; Women&#8217;s Health revenues declined primarily due to the loss of exclusivity on Estrace<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> Cream and Minastrin<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> 24, offset, in part, by growth for Lo Loestrin<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> driven by higher average selling prices and increased demand.&nbsp;&nbsp;GI revenues increased primarily due to growth for Linzess<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> resulting from increased demand which more than offset negative pricing pressure on the product.&nbsp;&nbsp;GI was negatively affected by the generic impact on Asacol<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2017 and 2016</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The decrease in net revenues in the year ended December 31, 2017 was primarily due to a decline in Diversified Brand revenues, Women&#8217;s Health revenues, and Gastrointestinal revenues versus the prior year period, offset, in part, by increases in Other Revenues and CNS revenues.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:12pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Diversified Brand revenues decreased due to a decline in Other Diversified Brands and <font style="color:#000000;">Bystolic<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174; </sup>/ Byvalson</font><sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>.&nbsp;&nbsp;<font style="color:#000000;">Bystolic<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174; </sup>/ Byvalson</font><sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174; </sup>revenues declined as a result of decreased demand offset in part by higher average selling prices.&nbsp;&nbsp;Other Diversified Brands declined due to demand declines and the impact of loss of exclusivity on certain products including Enablex<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> as well as a decline in PacPharma revenues as the Company out licensed these product rights.&nbsp;&nbsp;Included within &#8220;Other Revenues&#8221; for the year ended December 31, 2017 was an increase in royalty revenues related to these products of $30.3 million.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:12pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Women&#8217;s Health revenues declined primarily due to the loss of exclusivity on Minastrin<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> 24.&nbsp;&nbsp;Offsetting this decline, in part, were an increase in Taytulla<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> revenues of $72.4 million and increased sales of Lo Loestrin<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> due primarily to strong demand growth and higher average selling prices.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:12pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Declines within our Gastrointestinal franchise were primarily driven by a reduction in demand for Asacol<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> HD following the launch of an authorized generic in August 2016. Offsetting this decline, in part, was an increase in royalty revenue of $34.8 million relating to our authorized generic version of Asacol<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> HD, which was included within &#8220;Other Revenues&#8221;.&nbsp;&nbsp;Further offsetting this decline was growth in Linzess<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> and newly launched Viberzi<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>.&nbsp;&nbsp; Linzess<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> revenues increased primarily due to strong demand growth.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:12pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The increase in Central Nervous System revenues was driven by<font style="font-size:12pt;"> </font>the launch of Vraylar<font style="font-size:12pt;"><sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup></font> and Namzaric<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> offset, in part, by the continued decline in Namenda<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> due to decreased demand and conversion to Namzaric<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:2.27%;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Cost of Sales</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2018 and 2017</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The decrease in cost of sales in the year ended December 31, 2018 was primarily due to lower product sales and product mix in addition to the favorable impact of a $29.9 million Linzess<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> profit share true-up.&nbsp;&nbsp;Segment gross margin was 85.0% in the year ended December 31, 2018 compared to 85.4% in the prior year period as a result of product mix including the impact of generics on sales of Estrace<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> Cream.</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">58</a></p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU57"></a><font style="font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2017 and 2016</font></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The decrease in cost of sales was the result of lower product revenues and the impact of reacquiring rights on select licensed products in the year ended December 31, 2017 offset, in part, by unfavorable product mix. As a result of the reacquired rights, the Company is no longer obligated to pay royalties on the specific products, which increases the segment gross margin.&nbsp;&nbsp;In the year ended December 31, 2016, royalties incurred relating to the reacquired product rights were $71.3 million.</p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:2.27%;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Selling and Marketing Expenses </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2018 and 2017</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The decrease in selling and marketing expenses in the year ended December 31, 2018 was related to headcount reductions from the Company&#8217;s restructuring initiatives, lower promotional costs, and a decrease in the charge for the non-tax deductible Branded Prescription Drug Fee.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2017 and 2016</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The decrease in selling and marketing expenses related to headcount reductions and lower promotional costs.</p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:2.27%;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">General and Administrative Expenses</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2018 and 2017</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">General and administrative expenses in the year ended December 31, 2018 decreased period-over-period due to cost savings initiatives.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2017 and 2016</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">General and administrative expenses were in line period-over-period.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">59</a></p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">.</p>
<p style="margin-top:8pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:2.27%;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Net Revenues</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2018 and 2017</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The increase in net revenues in the year ended December 31, 2018 was primarily due to the operational growth of total Facial Aesthetics and Botox<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> Therapeutics, as well as the Zeltiq Acquisition.&nbsp;&nbsp;Within Facial Aesthetics, the increase in sales of Botox<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> Cosmetics was driven primarily by demand growth and higher average prices.&nbsp;&nbsp;The increase in sales of Botox<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> Therapeutics was driven primarily by demand growth.&nbsp;&nbsp;Juvederm<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> Collection revenues increased versus the prior year period, primarily resulting from demand growth.&nbsp;&nbsp;Within total Eye Care, Ozurdex<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> decreased versus the prior year period, primarily driven by the third quarter product recall and the temporary period of not shipping product.&nbsp;&nbsp;Plastic Surgery decreased versus the prior year period, primarily driven by a fourth quarter suspension of sales and withdrawal of the remaining textured breast implants from the market in Europe. This suspension and withdrawal followed the non-renewal of our textured breast implant&#160;CE Mark licenses in Europe pending a request for additional information by LNE-GMED, the notified body responsible for certification of our breast implants.&nbsp;&nbsp;Sales returns reserves recorded for the recalls totaled $56.7 million in the year ended December 31, 2018.<font style="color:#000000;font-family:Segoe UI;"> </font>&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2017 and 2016</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The increase in net revenues in the year ended December 31, 2017 was primarily due to the operational growth of total Facial Aesthetics, Eye Care and Botox<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> Therapeutics, as well as the acquisition of Zeltiq, which contributed $73.7 million of net revenues during the year ended December 31, 2017.&nbsp;&nbsp;Within Total Eye Care, Ozurdex<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> increased primarily due to demand growth.&nbsp;&nbsp;Within Facial Aesthetics, Juvederm<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> Collection revenues increased primarily resulting from demand growth.&nbsp;&nbsp;Botox<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> Cosmetics sales grew due to demand growth.&nbsp;&nbsp;Botox<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> Therapeutics sales also grew due to demand growth.&nbsp;&nbsp;International operational growth came from all regions primarily driven by Facial Aesthetics.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">62</a></p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:2.27%;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU60"></a><font style="font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Cost of Sales </font></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2018 and 2017</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The increase in cost of sales in the year ended December 31, 2018 was primarily due to the increase in net revenues and the Zeltiq Acquisition and the LifeCell Acquisition.&nbsp;&nbsp;Excluding the Zeltiq Acquisition and the LifeCell Acquisition in both periods, segment gross margin was 85.5% in the year ended December 31, 2018 compared to 86.1% in the prior year period.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2017 and 2016</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The increase in cost of sales was primarily due to the increase in net revenues.&nbsp;&nbsp;Segment gross margins of 85.6% for the year ended December 31, 2017 remained consistent with the prior year.</p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:2.27%;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Selling and Marketing Expenses </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2018 and 2017</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The increase in selling and marketing expenses in the year ended December 31, 2018 was due in part to the Zeltiq Acquisition as well as increased promotional spending in Medical Aesthetics.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2017 and 2016</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The increase in selling and marketing expenses related to the addition of Zeltiq, which contributed spending of $39.0 million, as well as increased promotional spending associated with Ozurdex<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>, Botox<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> Cosmetics and the Juvederm<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> Collection and recent product launches.</p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:2.27%;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">General and Administrative Expenses </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2018 and 2017</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">General and administrative expenses increased due in part to $12.4 million of contract tender costs associated with the Ozurdex and textured breast implants recalls.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2018 and 2017</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">General and administrative expenses were in line period-over-period.</p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-top:8pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:2.27%;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Integration</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2018, 2017 and 2016</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In the years ended December 31, 2018 and 2017, integration and restructuring charges included costs related to the integration of LifeCell and Zeltiq.&nbsp;&nbsp;In the year ended December&#160;31, 2016, integration and restructuring charges primarily related to the integration of the Legacy Allergan business as well as charges incurred with the terminated merger with Pfizer, Inc. of $124.9 million.&nbsp;&nbsp; </p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-top:8pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:2.27%;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Non-Acquisition Related Restructuring</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2018 and 2017</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In the years ended December 31, 2018 and 2017, the Company incurred charges related to the restructuring of its internal infrastructure.&nbsp;&nbsp;In the year ended December 31, 2018, the restructuring programs included charges associated with scaling our manufacturing plants and changes in the international commercial promotional focus in certain markets which include an anticipated reduction of approximately 200 sales representatives internationally.&nbsp;&nbsp;In the year ended December 31, 2017, restructuring programs included a mid-year commercial initiative as well as a December 2017 program.&nbsp;&nbsp;As part of these initiatives, the Company reduced its employee headcount within selling and marketing by approximately 350 as of December 31, 2017.&nbsp;&nbsp;A reduction of approximately 900 employees within cost of sales, selling and marketing and general and administrative was reserved for in the year ended December 31, 2017.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">64</a></p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-top:8pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:2.27%;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU61"></a><font style="font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Fair Value Adjustments</font></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2018 and 2017</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Fair value adjustments primarily relate to changes in estimated contingent liabilities for future amounts to be paid based on achievement of sales levels for the respective products.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In the year ended December 31, 2018, the income in cost of sales primarily reflects the reduction of the contingent liability for True Tear<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> when the product did not achieve a milestone event, as well as a corresponding decrease in commercial forecasts.&nbsp;&nbsp;The income recorded in the year ended December 31, 2017 primarily related to reduced or delayed revenue forecasts for select products including Rhofade<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> and Liletta<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup>.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-top:8pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:2.27%;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Effect of Purchase Accounting<font style="font-style:normal;"> </font></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2018, 2017 and 2016</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The Company incurred charges related to the purchase accounting impact on share-based compensation related to the Zeltiq Acquisition in the years ended December 31, 2018 and 2017, and the Allergan Acquisition and the Forest Acquisition in the years ended December 31, 2018, 2017 and 2016, which increased cost of sales, selling and marketing and general and administrative expenses.&nbsp;&nbsp;A cash stock-based compensation charge of $31.5 million associated with the Zeltiq Acquisition was also included in the year ended December 31, 2017.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In the year ended December 31, 2017, the Company incurred purchase accounting effects of $131.7 million in cost of sales related to the fair value inventory step-up from the LifeCell Acquisition and the Zeltiq Acquisition as products were sold to the Company&#8217;s third-party customers.&nbsp;&nbsp;In the year ended December 31, 2016, the Company incurred similar purchase accounting effects in cost of sales totaling $42.4 million related to the fair value inventory step-up from the Allergan Acquisition and the Forest Acquisition.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:2.27%;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Other</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:4.54%;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2018, 2017 and 2016</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In the years ended December 31, 2018, 2017 and 2016, general and administrative costs included legal settlement charges of $56.8 million, $96.5 million and $117.3 million, respectively.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-top:8pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:2.27%;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Revenues and Shared Costs</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:4.54%;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2018, 2017 and 2016</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Shared costs primarily include above site and unallocated costs associated with running our global manufacturing facilities and corporate general and administrative expenses.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In the year ended December 31, 2018, the Company recorded milestone revenue related to an on-going intellectual property agreement of $25.0 million.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:12pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In the year ended December 31, 2018, the increase in cost of goods sold within revenues and shared costs was primarily due to unfavorable inventory variances due to third-party manufacturing delays, an increase in compensation costs and $15.8 million of inventory write-offs associated with the Ozurdex<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> and textured breast implants product recalls versus the prior year.</p>
<p style="margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In the years ended December 31, 2018 and 2017, the Company incurred transactional foreign exchange losses of $28.8 million and $97.5 million, respectively, compared with transactional foreign exchange gains of $52.8 million, excluding mark-to-market unrealized losses for foreign currency option contracts, in the year ended December 31, 2016.</p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:2.27%;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Research and Development Expenses</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:6pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">R&amp;D expenses consist predominantly of personnel-related costs, active pharmaceutical ingredient costs, contract research, license and milestone fees, biostudy and facilities costs associated with product development.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">65</a></p>

<p style="margin-top:8pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:2.27%;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Operating Expenses</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:4.54%;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2018 and 2017</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The decrease in ongoing operating expenses in the year ended December 31, 2018 versus the year ended December 31, 2017, is mainly due to decreased product development spending in early stage development campaigns and the Eye Care therapeutic area as well as lower personnel costs offset, in part, by increased spending in the Central Nervous System and Gastrointestinal therapeutic areas.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:6pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2017 and 2016</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">The increase in ongoing operating expenses in the year ended December 31, 2017 versus the year ended December 31, 2016 is primarily due to increased product development spending primarily in the Central Nervous System and Gastrointestinal therapeutic areas coupled with higher personnel costs.</p>

<p style="margin-top:8pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:2.27%;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU63"></a><font style="font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Acquisition, Integration, and Restructuring Charges</font></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Year Ended December 31, 2017</p>
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Acquisition, integration and restructuring charges in the year ended December 31, 2017 included $37.1 million of severance and restructuring costs related to a planned internal reduction of approximately 200 R&amp;D employees and reduction of headcount due to the integration of acquired businesses.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-top:8pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:2.27%;text-indent:0%;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Contingent Consideration Adjustments, Net</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2018, 2017 and 2016</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:6pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In the year ended December 31, 2018, the net adjustment to contingent consideration primarily relates to the progression of R&amp;D projects relating to the Tobira Acquisition offset by a reduction in ForSight Acquisition contingent consideration.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:12pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In the year ended December 31, 2017, the adjustment to contingent consideration primarily related to the advancement of the Company&#8217;s True Tear<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> product and products acquired as part of the Tobira Acquisition.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:12pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">In the year ended December 31, 2016, the Company had net contingent consideration income of $71.1 million primarily driven by ongoing R&amp;D projects acquired in the Allergan Acquisition that were terminated based on clinical data, which was offset by additional contingent consideration expense relating to milestones achieved in connection with the AqueSys and Allergan acquisitions.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:9pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:2pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2018, 2017 and 2016</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Amortization for the year ended December 31, 2018 decreased as compared to the year ended December 31, 2017 primarily as a result of a decrease in amortization for Restasis<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> due to a reduced book value and remaining life as a result of an anticipated launch of a generic.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:12pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Amortization for the year ended December 31, 2017 increased as compared to the year ended December 31, 2016 primarily as a result of amortization related to the acquired LifeCell and Zeltiq products of $172.0 million, an increase in amortization for Restasis<sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup> based on a revised estimated useful life subsequent to the impairment charge taken in the quarter ended September 30, 2017, as well as amortization from approved products during the year ended December 31, 2016 and the year ended December 31, 2017. </p>
<p style="margin-top:18pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:2.27%;text-indent:0%;font-weight:bold;font-style:italic;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Goodwill, IPR&amp;D and Other Impairments and Asset Sales, Net</p>

<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:2pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU66"></a><a name="_MON_1496754356"></a><font style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_MON_1496754356"></a>The material drivers of the period-over-period tax rate movements are as follows:</font></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-style:italic;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Years Ended December 31, 2018 and 2017</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:6pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<div align="left">

<tr>

<td valign="top" style="width:3.33%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">(1)</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">The benefit to the 2018 effective tax rate was lower as compared to 2017 due to fewer losses in jurisdictions with tax rates higher than the Irish statutory rate, the reduction of the U.S. federal tax rate as a result of Tax Reform and the net impact of GILTI, which is being treated as a period cost in 2018 and was not included in 2017.</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:2.22%;white-space:nowrap">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p></td></tr></table></div>

<td valign="top">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:6pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">In 2018, the Company recorded amortization expense of $6.6 billion and intangible impairment charges of $3.0 billion, resulting in a tax benefit of $277.5 million, as a portion of these amounts were incurred in jurisdictions with tax rates higher than the Irish statutory rate.&nbsp;&nbsp;Comparatively, in 2017, the Company recorded amortization expense of $7.2 billion and impairment charges of $8.7 billion, including Teva Share Activity, resulting in a net tax benefit of $1,262.2 million, favorably impacting the 2017 effective tax rate as compared to 2018.</p></td>
<td valign="top" style="width:2.22%;white-space:nowrap">

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:12pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">For the year ended December 31, 2016, the Company recorded a deferred tax expense of $462.2 million to adjust its deferred tax assets related to investments in certain subsidiaries. The recognition of this expense has been reflected in &#8220;(Loss) / income from discontinued operations, net of tax.&#8221;&nbsp;&nbsp;Upon the closing of the Teva Transaction, the Company recorded the reversal of the corresponding deferred tax assets of $5,276.6 million against the current income taxes payable in continuing operations.</p>

<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:6pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Cash flows from operations represent net income adjusted for certain non-cash items and changes in assets and liabilities. Cash provided by operating activities decreased $438.9 million in the year ended December 31, 2018 versus the prior year period due to cash taxes of $722.5 million offset by other working capital items.</p>
<p style="margin-top:2pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Management expects that available cash balances will provide sufficient resources to fund our operating liquidity needs and expected capital expenditure funding requirements for at least the next twelve months.</p>
<p style="margin-top:2pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="text-align:center;margin-top:12pt;margin-top:12pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">72</a></p>
<hr style="page-break-after:always;width:100%;">
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><a name="_AEIOULastRenderedPageBreakAEIOU69"></a><font style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Investing cash flows for the year ended December 31, 2018 reflect the net cash provided by the sale of businesses and assets including Medical Dermatology and Rhofade</font><font style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><sup style="font-size:85%; vertical-align:top">&#174;</sup></font><font style="font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"> of $663.0 million and the net sale of investments of $3,124.6 million, offset, in part, by payments to settle Teva related matters of $466.0 million.&nbsp;&nbsp;Investing cash flows for the year ended December 31, 2017 reflect the net cash provided by the net sale of marketable securities of $5,369.5 million offset, in part, by the cash purchases of LifeCell for $2,874.4 million and Zeltiq of $2,346.7 million, net of cash acquired, and the purchase of intangible assets of $614.3 million.</font></p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:2pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Financing cash flows consist primarily of borrowings and repayments of debt, repurchases of ordinary shares, dividend payments and proceeds from the exercise of stock options.&nbsp;&nbsp;Cash used in financing activities in the year ended December 31, 2018 primarily related to the repayment of indebtedness of $8,804.5 million, the repurchase of ordinary shares of $2,775.4 million, the payment of dividends of $1,049.8 million, and payments to settle Teva-related matters of $234.0 million, which was outstanding greater than one year, offset, in part, by borrowings under the revolving credit facility of $700.0 million, the Euro senior note issuance of $1,919.7 million and other borrowings and proceeds from the forward sale of Teva shares of $465.5 million.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:2pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Cash used in financing activities in the year ended December 31, 2017 primarily related to the repayment of indebtedness of $6,413.6 million, which included debt repurchased under the tender offer<font style="font-size:12pt;"> </font>completed on May 30, 2017 and the early redemption of certain debt securities, the payment of dividends of $1,218.2 million and payments relating to contingent consideration and other financing of $511.6 million, and $493.0 million repurchases of ordinary shares, offset, in part by long-term borrowings of $3,550.0 million.</p>
<p style="margin-bottom:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-indent:0%;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;text-indent:4.54%;font-family:Times New Roman;font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">Our consolidated financial statements are prepared in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States (&#8220;GAAP&#8221;). These accounting principles require us to make certain estimates, judgments and assumptions. We believe that the estimates, judgments and assumptions are reasonable based upon information available to us at the time that these estimates, judgments and assumptions are made. These estimates, judgments and assumptions can affect the reported amounts of assets and liabilities as of the date of the financial statements, as well as the reported amounts of revenues and expenses during the periods presented. To the extent there are material differences between these estimates, judgments or assumptions and actual results, our financial statements will be affected. <p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;"><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;">&#x2022;</font></p></td>
<td valign="top">
<p style="margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:0pt;font-weight:normal;font-style:normal;text-transform:none;font-variant: normal;font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;"><font style="font-family:Times New Roman;">Income Taxes</font></p></td></tr></table></div>
<div align="left">
